name: jump-app-playwright-framework
description: Playwright framework for Jump App automation

scripts.test:staging: npm run clean:allure && cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npx playwright test
scripts.test:staging:smoke: npm run clean:allure && cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npx playwright test --grep @smoke
scripts.test:staging:regression: npm run clean:allure && cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npx playwright test --grep @regression
scripts.test:staging:clean: npm run test:staging || echo 'Test run has failures. Check the report for details.'
scripts.allure:generate: npm run allure:copy:history && allure generate allure-results --clean
scripts.test:staging:allure:open: npm run clean:allure && cross-env NODE_ENV=staging npx playwright test || echo 'Test run has failures. Check the report for details.' && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open

author: Jump App
